Gannawarra Shire Site Tour

Gannawarra Councillors joined members of
the VHM team in May to obtain an update on
the status of the Project and visit the Project
site as part of a review of projects within their
Shire.





Accommodation Expression of Interest

The Accommodation Expression of Interest is progressing well. Interviews with prospective accommo-
dation providers for the Project were conducted late in June. Review of the submissions from the
Companies being interviewed is now underway.


                                     Next Steps in Approvals Process

                                        With the Environment Effects Statement (EES) en-
                                       dorsement received and Mining Licence approved, all
                                        necessary remaining secondary approvals to construct,
                                          operate and close the project are progressing. This will
                                             include a Work Plan which will provide governance over
                                           operations at the Goschen Project.

                                   As the Mining Licence holder, the Company will be en-
                                                         titled to mine the land covered by the licence; explore
                                                    for minerals and construct mining facilities related to the
                                         mining operation. The licence covers the areas outlined
                                                    in yellow, in the insert map above.


Works in the Area

The below works are planned for the coming months so you may notice some work crews in the
area. Please note our contractors and sub-contractors have been briefed on the need to adhere to
speed limits and to respect the community when using local roads.

Cultural Heritage survey work at Kangaroo Lake and along the pipeline route
Native vegetation survey work
Detail design and survey work for Kangaroo Lake Pipeline
Groundwater and Air quality monitoring around the proposed mine site
